title: Fed-GRPO: Reward-Signal-Driven Federated Group Relative Policy Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.11502v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong reasoning capabilities when fine-tuned with reinforcement learning (RL), particularly through Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). However, existing GRPO methods assume centralized access to training data, which may not hold in practice due to privacy or regulatory constraints. To this end, we propose Fed-GRPO, a federated GRPO training framework that addresses these privacy constraints by enabling collaborative reasoning training without sharing raw data, which leverages the reward statistics naturally produced during GRPO training as zero-cost signals to guide aggregation, local training, and communication. Fed-GRPO contains three reward-signal-driven mechanisms: (i) \emph{signal-weighted aggregation} that weights clients by their reward standard deviation, prioritizing clients with stronger learning signals; (ii) \emph{global reward calibration} that re-weights per-prompt objectives

translated_title: Fed-GRPO：奖励信号驱动的联邦组相对策略优化
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在经过强化学习（RL）微调后展现出了强大的推理能力，尤其是通过组相对策略优化（GRPO）。然而，现有的GRPO方法假设可以集中访问训练数据，但由于隐私或监管限制，这在实际中可能无法成立。为此，我们提出了Fed-GRPO，一个联邦GRPO训练框架，通过无需共享原始数据即可进行协作推理训练来解决这些隐私限制，该框架利用GRPO训练过程中自然产生的奖励统计信息作为零成本信号来指导聚合、本地训练和通信。Fed-GRPO包含三种奖励信号驱动机制：（i）信号加权聚合，根据客户端的奖励标准差对其进行加权，优先考虑具有更强学习信号的客户端；（ii）全局奖励校准，对每个提示的目标进行重新加权
tldr: 该论文提出Fed-GRPO框架，利用GRPO训练中天然产生的奖励统计信号来驱动联邦聚合、本地训练与通信，在保护数据隐私的同时实现大模型协作推理训练。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Fed-GRPO, a federated GRPO framework that leverages reward statistics naturally produced during training as zero-cost signals to drive aggregation, local training, and communication, enabling privacy-preserving collaborative reasoning training for LLMs.
